title: AWS Fundamentals & Cloud Concepts
description: Learn cloud computing basics, AWS global infrastructure, management tools, and the Well-Architected Framework.
longDescription: This module covers the absolute basics of Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will learn what cloud computing means, the difference between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS, how AWS organizes its global network of regions and availability zones, what tools are available to manage your AWS account, and how the Well-Architected Framework helps you build reliable systems.
whatYouLearn: Explain cloud computing and deployment models
Navigate AWS regions, AZs, and edge locations
Use AWS Console, CLI, and SDKs
